binding_hypotheses.claim: 2x2-corner-only fixed-frame observations alias 3x3 edge states; task-relative physical coverage differs
learned algorithm class can restrict attainable short solutions independent of global geodesic
low HTM move count need not mean low physical speed solve time
lookahead, chunking and recognition constraints may change effective M* under budgets
fast heuristic vs deliberative planned candidate selection could affect policy

critical_invariants: Official WCA events 222 and 333 performance time is not an observation of cognition
Source authored FMC alternatives are NOT independent participant trials
The 451 naturalistic 3x3 traces are privately held and cannot be publicly redistributed
PDB physical ranking is about 3x3 DR search not 2x2 participant performance
2x2-corner projection is fixed orientation cube mathematical quotient, not complete competition-level 2x2 metric
M*(5)=8 belongs only to frozen finite resettable 0.19 physical observational model
Lean theorem cannot establish human cognitive cause
